claim.claim-text: an RF signal connecting portion (31) spaced apart, by a predetermined distance, from an outer member having an electrode pad provided on a surface thereof; and a terminal portion (340, 440) configured to electrically connect the electrode pad of the outer member and the RF signal connecting portion (31) so as to absorb assembly tolerance existing at the predetermined distance and to prevent disconnection of the electric flow between the electrode pad and the RF signal connecting portion (31), wherein the terminal portion (340, 440) comprises:

first side terminal (350, 450) contacted with the electrode pad; and the second side terminal (360, 460) connected to the RF signal connecting portion (31), wherein at least any one of the first side terminal (350, 450) and the second side terminal (360, 460) has a housing space in which the other side terminal (350, 360, 450, 460) is housed, and a part (352, 452) of the at least one side terminal (350, 360, 450, 460) is elastically deformed by an assembly force provided by an assembler, and applies lateral tension to the other side terminal (350, 360, 450, 460) while elastically supporting the other side terminal (350, 360, 450, 460) toward the electrode pad, wherein an upper end portion of the second side terminal (360, 460) is housed in the lower end portion of the first side terminal (350, 450), and the first side terminal (350, 450) has tension cut portions (355, 455) formed therein so as to be widened along the outer surface of the upper end portion (361, 461) of the second side terminal (360, 460) when the first side terminal (350, 450) is moved downward by an assembly force provided by an assembler.
2. The connecting structure of claim 1, wherein the upper end portion (361) of the second side terminal (360) is formed in a cone shape.
3. The connecting structure of claim 1, wherein the upper end portion (461) of the second side terminal (460) is formed in a shape obtained by cutting out a part of the cone-shaped upper end portion.

4. The connecting structure of claim 1, wherein a contact portion (353, 453) of the first side terminal (350, 450), which is contacted with the electrode pad, has a ring-shaped horizontal cross-sectional shape.

5. The connecting structure of claim 1, wherein the lower end portion (362, 462) of the second side terminal (360, 460) is soldered and fixed to a solder hole (32) formed in the plate of the RF signal connecting portion (31).

6. The connecting structure of claim 1, wherein the connecting structure further comprises a reinforcement plate (395, 495) having a terminal through-hole (397, 497) through which the second side terminal (360, 460) pass.

7. The connecting structure of claim 6, wherein the connecting structure further comprises a dielectric body (370, 470) placed on top of the reinforcement plate (395, 495) and having a terminal through-hole (371, 471) through which the first side terminal (350, 450) pass.
8. The connecting structure of claim 1, wherein a lower end portion (452) of a first side terminal (450) is downwardly inclined at a predetermined angle toward the outside.
